subject: nations

refused.reason: no seat recruits Native nations or Native men, or counts them as manpower: a nation's people are never a pool either side draws on (SENSITIVE-HISTORY 3.7, refused; 0021)

recruitment, manpower or population aimed at a nation's government or its land (the nations' departments, their regions and the Leased District) treats its people as a pool, which no seat may draw on (SENSITIVE-HISTORY 3.7, refused; 0070)
no principal has a verb to recruit Native nations or Native men: their enlistment, on either side, is their own choice, derived from conditions and policy (SENSITIVE-HISTORY 3.7, refused; rule 5)
a nation is never either side's possession: only its own act changes its side or closes its land (0069, 0070)

windowBasis: [I] Candidate review envelope, not an incident trigger, publication date or proof of receipt. A named act still needs its own source/date. Inherited windows are byte-for-byte unchanged.

facets.recommendation: [I] Continue nations’ own councils, treaties and changes of side, not Confederate possessions. 1862 refugees and campaigns require their own voices/source bounds.
[I] Nation decisions, neutrality, enlistment and loyalist flight remain agency terms; diplomacy is not a manpower allocation.
[I] Retain internal divisions and slavery within nations. Refugee estimates differ in date/population; no single pooled Native will or erased Black Creeks.

agencyReasonNotes: [I] Each reason names people’s own choices responding to conditions; protected inputs have no player writer. The ids are candidate vocabulary, not implemented terms.

triggerRules.policy: [I] Whole-word rules from triggerMatches; use the live proper-noun allowlist as well. A match requests review, never assigns a topic automatically. No gate:none approval is supplied.

topicRules: GCF’s treaty list/summary is not full treaty text. Contested Reserve/Leased District interpretation remains held.
No invented words/aim for Opothleyahola or the chiefs’ petition. A nation’s alliance is its own act; no annex/recruit label.
